## Work out if you need to lodge
### Reason 3
- your taxable income (from taxable income or loss in your tax return) is more than **$22,575**.

### Reason 4
- your taxable income is more than
  - **$18,200** if you're an [Australian resident for tax purposes](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/coming-to-australia-or-going-overseas/your-tax-residency/australian-resident-for-tax-purposes) for the full income year

### Other reasons
- You derive Australian source taxable income (excluding any super remainder or employment termination remainder) of **$45,001** or more while on a working holiday visa (417 or 462 visa).

## Starting your first job
### Claiming the tax-free threshold
In some situations, your employer will not withhold tax from your income because they don't expect you to earn over $18,200 from what they pay you throughout the year.
